detail.longDescription: Hey HN! I got this idea that Jev would be a good fit for content moderation, so I investigated how good it is exactly, see my write up at https://tn1ck.com/blog/jevdit And it is actually quite good at it and dirt cheap. I built this reddit like site to see if it actually holds true when exposed to the internet. Anyone who visits gets immediately an anonymous account. It's a simple server side rendered go application, it uses Cloudflare Turnstile to limit bots.
